sections.name: cn
sections.title: Style joining helper
sections.what: Joins style names and removes conflicting duplicates so the caller's style wins.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets callers override the base look.
sections.watch_out: A caller's style can silently replace a base style.

sections.name: IndustrialCardProps
sections.title: Settings for a card
sections.what: Lists the title, accent colour, content, header action, and the standard element settings.
sections.why: Lets callers add a title and actions.
sections.watch_out: The accent colour is accepted but unused.

sections.name: IndustrialCard
sections.title: Card layout
sections.what: Draws the card with a lift on hover, a title bar when needed, and a padded body.
sections.why: Likely reason: a hover lift suggests the card can be clicked.
sections.watch_out: The hover lift applies even to cards that cannot be clicked.

summary: A bordered white card with an optional title bar, an action area and a padded body.
purpose: Gives cards one standard look across the app.
why: Likely reason: consistent layout in many places.
how: Combines the base style with any extra style passed in, draws the title bar only when a title or action is given, and puts the content in the body.
inputs: Optional title, accent colour, content, header action, extra style and other standard element settings.
risks: The accent colour option is accepted but not used in the drawn styles.
debug: If a card looks unstyled, check the extra style being passed in.
